params.body:
v0.23.0: `/v1/agents` names each grant by a digest (control#66), so Elixir's supervisor can see that the VM serves an older grant than the box writes and say so in its job note (elixir#208) instead of a hand finding out as "resource not in grant".

Gateway sha256 from the release's `SHA256SUMS`: `de79b9d087580e0fb2eba6aa2b6f076be37cf590df4be9e7826562cc3508eda2`.

After merge: `rehearse.sh upgrade`, then `rehearse.sh config` with this box's current `config.json` (which also carries the vera grant the VM is still missing) and a restart.
params.title: De VM op v0.23.0: een vergunning met een naam
